item.description:
Release v5.3.0

Changes since v5.2.1

  • feat: add brief verbosity mode support for message renderer plugin
  • feat: add pin/unpin support for conversation list
  • feat: register ConversationContextSizePlugin in LumiFactory
  • feat(activity-heatmap): add detailed activity statistics
  • feat(activity-heatmap): batch cache save, token versioning, and skeleton loading animations
  • feat(ActivityHeatmapPlugin): add "Open Data Directory" button to settings view
  • feat(AgentTempStoragePlugin): register 3 temp file tools to the system
  • feat(AgentTurn): add structured tool control results
  • feat(AgentTurn): resume parents after child work
  • feat(AskUser): resume suspended turns through the manager
  • feat(conversation-list): prevent redundant publishes and add pin/unpin localization
  • feat(conversation-store): make order optional for lightweight migration and add setConversationOrder
  • feat(ConversationContextSizePlugin): add context size display to chat toolbar
  • feat(ConversationReasoningPlugin): add conversation reasoning effort control
  • feat(DeviceInfoPlugin): add Lumi app's own memory usage monitor
  • feat(DeviceInfoPlugin): add memory monitor settings page
  • feat(LLMProviderManager): add daily token usage series and settings UI
  • feat(LLMProviderManager): add providerInfo method to protocol
  • feat(LLMProviderStepFunPlugin): generalize build agent to support multiple project types
  • feat(Localization): localize plugin settings and exchange UI
